environment.broker: RabbitMQ container zhijuan-workflow-20260922-mq, dedicated vhost zhijuan-accept-w6 (created for this run; daily vhost zhijuan-local untouched)
environment.worker: real Celery worker subprocess: .venv/bin/celery -A services.worker.jobs:app worker --pool=solo --concurrency=1 --without-gossip --without-mingle --without-heartbeat
environment.hermes: two FakeHermesServer instances on loopback (author/solver separated), protocol mirrors vendor api_server_runs.py: POST /v1/runs 202 {run_id}, GET /v1/runs/{id} with run_id echo + completed flag + output JSON string + usage, POST stop

command: ZHIJUAN_SKIP_DOTENV=1 DATABASE_URL=$TEST_DSN ZHIJUAN_TEST_DATABASE_URL=$TEST_DSN CELERY_BROKER_URL=$ACCEPT_VHOST_URL python -m unittest tests.integration.test_queue_runtime -v

cases.assertions: dispatch>=1 -> worker consumes -> author admissions=1, solver admissions=1 -> COMPLETED; results=1 with overall REVIEW (no trusted math); duplicate dispatch_outbox() does not re-admit (admissions stay 1)
cancel then dispatch: author admissions=0, solver admissions=0, job CANCELLED
author admission returns 500: exactly 1 attempt (admit_failures=1, admissions=0), no repost, job RECONCILING, solver never called
stored plan_snapshot/spec_snapshot and slot score_x100=100 preserved through worker run

notes: Worker readiness proven by real heartbeat row (component=worker, runtime_id=zhijuan-accept-w6, metadata model_id/gateway host:port).

Two earlier FAIL runs were test-design artifacts, not product defects: (a) leftover pending outbox rows from a debug run were dispatched by later tests' dispatch_outbox (fixed by truncating job runtime tables in tearDown on the disposable test DB); (b) the intentional duplicate-dispatch check wrongly asserted dispatch count >= 1 although 0 is the correct behavior after the row is marked dispatched (fixed by splitting first-dispatch and duplicate-dispatch assertions). A controlled experiment (manual worker, no test process, clean DB, 6s window) confirmed no external dispatcher exists and an undispatched job stays QUEUED.

not_run here: status-poll timeout/wrong-run_id fault windows (covered offline by tests/test_hermes_runs_transport.py), SSE stream behavior (browser phase), pause/resume transitions (covered offline), multi-slot ordering (single-slot plan).
